messages:
liz: FYI I'm about to run a terraform plan for an AZ shard / IP rebalance in inference-prod VPC to free up capacity for upcoming GPU node pools. PR with plan: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/412

liz: High level — create a small /24 in us-west-2a, migrate a few low-risk services, update route table associations, and centralize NAT allocation to reduce EIP churn. Hoping for quick network review.

raj: quick q — will this touch TGW attachments or any PrivateLink endpoint subnets? I need to know for route propagation and mesh policies.

liz: It should NOT touch TGW attachments. Only modifying route table associations for analytics-subnet and inference-workers-subnet. PrivateLink endpoints (s3, ecr) remain in place. tf diff excerpt below: 
```terraform
# terraform plan snippet
resource "aws_subnet" "inference_workers_usw2a" {
  cidr_block = "10.40.32.0/24" -> "10.40.33.0/24"
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false
  tags = { Name = "inference-workers-usw2a" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "analytics" {
  subnet_id = aws_subnet.analytics_subnet.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.private.id -> aws_route_table.analytics.id
}
```

maria: Can you confirm how NAT gateway/EIP allocation will change? If EIPs rotate we need to update firewall/NAT allowances.

liz: Good question — switching from per-az NATs to a centralized NAT in us-west-2b, but we'll reuse the same EIP pool (eipalloc-0a1b2c). Cutover should be ~10m; I'll coordinate firewall windows.

sam: Tagging note — if you move node groups make sure subnets keep the k8s cluster tags (k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled) otherwise ASG placement breaks.

liz: Yep will add tags in the PR. Planning a canary apply to staging first. Proposed apply window: 2025-11-03T15:00Z.

infra-bot: terraform plan ran: 3 to add, 2 to change, 1 to destroy. No drift detected. Plan link: https://ci.redwood/plan/789

raj: lgtm from networking side. @maria can you ack firewall change?

maria: Acked. Firewall rule update approved. I'll monitor the UTM logs during the cutover :eyes:

oncall: Reminder to ping on-call before you apply. Also pre-create a route table backup snapshot and validate BGP sessions.

liz: Will do. Short runbook snippet before apply: 
```
- precheck: ensure BGP sessions healthy and TGW attachments show active
- snapshot: aws ec2 create-route-table-snapshot --rtb-id rtb-0123456789abcdef
- apply: terraform apply -auto-approve 
- post: verify pod IP allocation and internet egress via `kubectl run -it --rm --restart=Never check-ip --image=curlimages/curl -- curl http://httpbin.org/ip`
- rollback: terraform apply -var 'revert=true'
```

sam: Also set TF var `enable_cross_zone=false` explicitly in the PR — we've hit sticky session issues when it's implicit.

liz: added that var in a followup commit. Pushed.

raj: small nit — bump the tfstate lock timeout to 600s during this run in CI so we don't race with autoscaling tasks.

liz: Doing that in the apply pipeline. I'll post when I start the staging apply.

infra-bot: apply queued by liz at 1765432360 — lock acquired.

maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
